what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1977?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1977 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (grep for gross, wages, payroll, salary) found only the aggregate `Gross Payroll, Regular` / `Gross Payroll, School` lines of the sample cash flow sheet (p37, unreadable as a table), the `Special Details Wages` lines of the Treasurer's statements (p41, p47) and the school personnel listing (p125-143), which names staff with education and position but no pay — closes: the Town Accountant's payroll register for calendar or fiscal 1977

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1978?
why: `salary-schedule` reads Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1977 report records only the article (p75 Article 3: `deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on April 3, 1976 ... and substituting therefor the Classification and Salary Schedule proposed by the Personnel Committee and appearing in the report of the Finance Committee`) and not the schedule; searched the whole text for `salary schedule` and `classification` (p75, and the accountant's `KEY TO CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS`) — closes: the Finance Committee's 1977 report, or the Personnel Committee's schedule voted April 2, 1977

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1977, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1977 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general account balance sheet (p50 `Revolving Funds: School Lunch 47,497.99, School Athletics 12.38`), and the School Department's own accounts with spending (p155-156 school lunch, p160-162 special accounts); searched revolving, special revenue and fund across the text — closes: the Town Accountant's fund ledgers for fiscal 1977

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1977?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1977 report prints no such schedule: the accountant's schedule lists each article (p55-66) and the special articles voted are on p76-77, so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown; searched `capital` (p37 `Capital Expenditures` on the sample cash flow sheet only) — closes: the Town Accountant's year-end report by fund

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1978?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation by class, levy and overlay from 2000-2010. The 1977 report prints a valuation of $66,890,790 (real estate) and $3,203,280 (personal property) and a tax rate of $48.00 on p3, and the Assessors estimate new growth in prose (p8: `in the area of three quarters of a million dollars`); no class breakdown, no levy and no overlay. The balance sheet shows `Overlay Reserved for Abatements: Levy of 1977 30,973.95` (p50). Searched valuation, tax rate and overlay — closes: the Assessors' tax recapitulation for fiscal 1978

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1977, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's activity from the 2000s. The 1977 report prints three counts in prose (printed page 21, in the text: 70 devices found correct and sealed, 11 scales and pumps adjusted, 5 not sealed) and no table and no fees by device — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' annual return to the Division of Standards

what: What did the town pay each vendor over $4,000 in fiscal 1977?
why: `report-vendor-payments` holds payments over $4,000 to one payee from the 1986 report. Searched the text for vendor, 4,000 and c.40 s.4G: the 1977 report prints none — closes: the Town Accountant's accounts-payable detail for fiscal 1977

what: What was the Treasurer's month-end cash on hand in fiscal 1977, by month?
why: `report-cash-management` holds the State-required monthly cash management chart (1981). The 1977 report prints only a sample weekly cash flow and investment income ESTIMATE for February 1978 (p37), unreadable as a table (listed in NEEDS.md), and prose on cash management (p38-39) — closes: the Treasurer's monthly cash reports to the Division of Local Services for fiscal 1977
